title: Ben Rich's deathbed remarks to Jim Goodall

tellings.quote: He said, "Jim, we have things out in the desert." And he wasn't referring to Area 51.
We have things out in the desert that is 50 years beyond what you can comprehend.
tellings.difference: Adds that the things are '50 years beyond what you can comprehend' and gives the date as c. 1993-1995.
tellings.link_reason: This is Ben Rich's remark to Jim Goodall that 'we have things out in the desert', the same deathbed conversation.

as_told.title: Ben Rich: 'we have things out in the desert'

plain: On his deathbed around 1995, Ben Rich, who had run Lockheed's secret aircraft division, told a friend: "Jim, we have things out in the desert," and he did not mean Area 51, the well-known secret test site. The aviation writer Jim Goodall says Rich said it to him in hospital, and in a later episode he adds that Rich called the things "50 years beyond what you can comprehend."
